body: Installed FORGE_ORGANISM_CHARTER_v5 as a proper skill and ran its own step 1 immediately, since the charter itself says that step gates everything else. Did NOT just accept its illustrative numbers (0.711 trim compounding, 99% vanished trades) as true for this codebase -- traced the actual claim against the real code instead. Result: the conviction-probability gate is fine, already matches what the charter recommends. But found a real, more concrete version of the same defect elsewhere: your LIVE entry check scores with CalculateEnhancedUnifiedScore (the full 14-layer, session/volatility-blended, CATREC-damped scorer) against a threshold that EVERY calibration phase (P1/P2/P3B) set using CalculateUnifiedScoreCoreAtBar -- a simpler linear scorer with none of that blending or damping. Same underlying scale-mismatch class the charter warns about, and actually the live-side twin of something WARRANT#92 partially surfaced earlier tonight. I did NOT fix this -- it touches the live entry-decision function directly, which needs its own explicit review, not a same-pass patch. Instead I added a read-only measurement (WARRANT#100) that runs right after Phase 3B commits: samples 500 bars, scores each with both functions using the identical final weights, and reports how many bars each scorer would actually qualify at the current threshold. New log line 'forge-organism portal-audit' -- that's the real number, not my guess. Compiled clean, not live-tested yet. Everything's in the mailbox: source, ex4, ledger through pass_81, and the new skill file itself.
